pois.name: Varkala Cliff Walk & Sunset Point
pois.description: Walk along Varkala's iconic red cliffs overlooking the Arabian Sea. Explore seaside cafés, local handicraft shops, coconut groves, and panoramic coastal viewpoints before afternoon crowds arrive.
pois.ai_reason:
✓ Best visited in the morning before crowds
✓ Only 350m from your next stop
✓ Free attraction within your budget
✓ Panoramic Arabian Sea views
pois.tip: Visit before 9:00 AM or after 5:00 PM for the best sea breeze and comfortable temperatures.

pois.name: Café Del Mar Varkala
pois.description: Relax at a premier cliffside café featuring open-air ocean seating, fresh Kerala seafood curries, wood-fired pizzas, and organic tropical fruit smoothies.
pois.ai_reason:
✓ Located directly on Middle Cliff (350m walk)
✓ Fits lunch schedule perfectly
✓ Highly rated for fresh seafood & vegetarian options
✓ Ocean view dining
pois.tip: Grab an ocean-facing balcony table on the upper deck for unobstructed sea views.
pois.signature_dish: Kerala Grilled Fish Curry & Mango Smoothie

pois.name: Janardhana Swamy Temple
pois.description: Visit a 2,000-year-old historic Vishnu temple situated near the sea, known for its intricate Kerala wood carvings, ancient banyan tree, and sacred temple pond.
pois.ai_reason:
✓ 2000-year-old historic cultural landmark
✓ Free entry
✓ Matches cultural sightseeing interest
✓ 4.6★ reviews
pois.tip: Dress modestly (shoulders and knees covered) when entering the main temple courtyard.
